name: Legislation type
description: The kind of legislative document this is. Kept broad on purpose, since the same word means different things in different legal systems. Pick whichever term comes closest, and put the local name in alternateName.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Code
hasDefinedTerm.description: A consolidated body of law, like a municipal code.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Ordinance
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local law meant to apply generally and permanently.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Resolution
hasDefinedTerm.description: A statement of position or an administrative decision, usually without lasting legal force.

hasDefinedTerm.name: By-law
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local law — the usual term in Commonwealth countries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Act
hasDefinedTerm.description: Primary legislation passed by a national or regional legislature.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Regulation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Secondary legislation made using power an act hands down.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Decree
hasDefinedTerm.description: An order issued by an executive authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Directive
hasDefinedTerm.description: An instrument that requires a result but leaves the method up to whoever carries it out.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Motion
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposal put to a group for a decision.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Charter
hasDefinedTerm.description: The document that sets up the government itself.
